companies.name: Crevel Europe GmbH
companies.distributes: Imported confectionery, snacks and beverages plus international grocery (American, Mexican and Asian ranges).
companies.channels_supplied: B2B importer and brand builder; site shows EDEKA, REWE, METRO, TEDi and Transgourmet among customers in 33+ European markets. Jena reached through these national chains, not confirmed directly.
companies.fit_rationale: Its whole model is importing foreign branded sweets and snacks and building them in German retail, which is exactly what Diablo needs. Customer logos include chains with stores in Jena (EDEKA, REWE, TEDi, METRO).
what_they_do_well: Imports, distributes and builds international food brands such as Tajin, Herr's and Van Holten's for B2B customers across 33+ European markets.

companies.name: tabacon TABAKWAREN GmbH & Co. KG
companies.distributes: Tobacco (about 98 percent of sales), confectionery, drinks and spirits, smoking accessories and prepaid cards.
companies.channels_supplied: Shops, kiosks and petrol stations across eastern Germany and Bavaria, from a Thuringian base near Gera.
companies.fit_rationale: Family owned Thuringian wholesaler about 50 km from Jena with a decision maker who can be reached, already adding sweets to kiosk and petrol station deliveries. Sugar free sweets would be a differentiated add-on to a range that is still mostly tobacco.
what_they_do_well: Family owned wholesaler supplying over 2,700 shops, kiosks and petrol stations from Rugen to Passau with more than 4,000 items.
Reported sales above 380 million euros, with branches in Berlin and Nurnberg as well as Ronneburg.

companies.name: East Trading Company GmbH
companies.distributes: International sweets, gummies, chocolate, snacks and drinks.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesalers and retailers, with delivery, shipping or pickup from Halle in central Germany. Named customers not found.
companies.fit_rationale: A central German importer and wholesaler of international sweets about 80 km from Jena, so imported branded confectionery is its core business. Flagged: confirmed only from a directory profile because its own site could not be read, so check size and range on first contact.

companies.name: Lekkerland Deutschland
companies.distributes: Confectionery, snacks, beverages, coffee, tobacco, food service, private label and non-food.
companies.channels_supplied: Petrol station shops, convenience stores, kiosks, coffee shops and charging stations; about 40,000 outlets in Germany. Borna logistics centre serves Central Germany.
companies.fit_rationale: The leading supplier of sweets and snacks to petrol stations and kiosks in Central Germany, including around Jena, and it runs a newcomer products section. A large REWE Group business, so listing is central and slower than with an owner-run importer.
what_they_do_well: Supplies around 40,000 outlets in Germany from 12 logistics centres with 368 own vehicles.
Its Borna logistics centre serves about 3,400 petrol station, kiosk and DIY store customers across Central Germany (2015 report).

companies.name: EDEKA Foodservice (EDEKA C+C Grossmarkt Jena)
companies.based_out_of: Jena, Germany (local market; group head office not verified)
companies.distributes: Full range food and drink cash and carry with over 13,000 items; confectionery range not itemised on the page.
companies.channels_supplied: Trade customers in Jena and Thuringia through on-site cash and carry and a delivery service.
companies.fit_rationale: The only food wholesale market physically in Jena (Wiesenstrasse 102), so it reaches local caterers, kiosks and independent shops directly. Listing may need EDEKA central buying approval.
what_they_do_well: Runs a Jena cash and carry market with over 13,000 items, offering both on-site shopping and a delivery service.

companies.name: IMV Spezialitaeten-Import Marketing und Vertriebs GmbH
companies.distributes: Imported chocolate, nougat, sweets and baked goods from small makers, plus spirits and delicatessen.
companies.channels_supplied: Specialist retailers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (sweet shops, delicatessens, florists, lifestyle stores), hospitality and corporate gifts. Jena shops not named.
companies.fit_rationale: A second generation family importer of European confectionery whose customers are the specialist sweet and gift shops where a premium sugar free range sells well. Its premium craft positioning may limit how much of Diablo's mainstream range it takes.
what_they_do_well: Family business in its second generation, sourcing confectionery from small makers worldwide for over 25 years.

companies.name: Noris Tabak & Convenience GmbH
companies.distributes: Confectionery, snacks, beverages, spirits, coffee and tobacco, plus convenience non-food.
companies.channels_supplied: Press and tobacco retailers and other resale outlets, delivered nationwide up to five times a week. Thuringia not named but covered by the nationwide claim.
companies.fit_rationale: Convenience wholesaler with sweets and snacks in its core range and a warehouse in Kassel, within reach of Jena. A sugar free line would broaden its kiosk offer, though tobacco remains its anchor.
what_they_do_well: Delivers nationwide up to five times a week from warehouses in Nurnberg, Leverkusen and Kassel.

companies.name: G-Border Trade GmbH
companies.distributes: Sweets and snacks, soft drinks, energy drinks, alcohol, shisha tobacco and smoking accessories.
companies.channels_supplied: Kiosk and petrol station trade, shipped across Germany within 24 hours. Named customers not found.
companies.fit_rationale: A specialist kiosk wholesaler with sweets and snacks as a main category and nationwide shipping that reaches Jena kiosks and Spaetis. Smaller and more transactional than tier 1, with no field sales confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Specialist kiosk and petrol station wholesaler shipping orders within 24 hours, free from 500 euros excluding drinks.

companies.name: CHEFS CULINAR (CHEFS CULINAR Ost)
companies.distributes: Full range foodservice food including frozen goods for professional kitchens.
companies.channels_supplied: Hospitals, care homes, hotels and restaurants in Saxony-Anhalt, Saxony, Thuringia, parts of Brandenburg and the Czech Republic.
companies.fit_rationale: The leading foodservice supplier to Thuringian hospitals and care homes, where diabetic and sugar free options are in real demand. Confectionery depth in its range was not confirmed.
what_they_do_well: Family-run foodservice wholesaler serving hospitals, care homes, hotels and restaurants across Saxony-Anhalt, Saxony and Thuringia since 1995.

companies.name: METRO Deutschland (METRO Erfurt)
companies.distributes: Full range food and drink cash and carry, including confectionery and snacks.
companies.channels_supplied: Restaurants, caterers, kiosks and independent retailers buying at the Erfurt market (Linderbacher Weg 32) and through delivery.
companies.fit_rationale: The nearest METRO to Jena, and the main cash and carry alternative since Selgros Erfurt closed. Listing is decided centrally, so this is a slower route than an owner-run importer.

companies.name: EDEKA Nordbayern-Sachsen-Thueringen
companies.distributes: Full range grocery wholesale, including confectionery, to EDEKA, E center, Marktkauf and diska stores.
companies.channels_supplied: About 865 stores in northern Bavaria, northern Baden-Wurttemberg, Thuringia and Saxony, many run by independent EDEKA retailers (2020).
companies.fit_rationale: The regional wholesale arm that stocks EDEKA and Marktkauf stores in and around Jena, so a regional listing here puts Diablo on Jena shelves. Independent EDEKA retailers can also take regional lines, but central category management makes it slower.
what_they_do_well: Supplies about 865 EDEKA, E center, Marktkauf and diska stores across Thuringia, Saxony and northern Bavaria (2020 figures).

companies.name: Rila Feinkost-Importe GmbH & Co. KG
companies.distributes: Imported speciality foods: sauces, spreads, snacks and sweet specialities, world cuisines and organic lines.
companies.channels_supplied: Wholesale, food service and its own online shop; field sales work at store level. Thuringian customers not named.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Online shop has a no added sugar filter; brands within it not identified.
companies.fit_rationale: An established owner-run importer that takes on foreign brands exclusively and sells them in with its own field sales team, a model that suits Diablo's spreads and syrups. Its focus is savoury and ethnic food, so confectionery would be a new push.
what_they_do_well: Over 50 years sourcing international speciality foods from its base in East Westphalia.
Uses its own field sales team to place newly taken-on brands at store level.

companies.name: World of Sweets GmbH
companies.distributes: Confectionery from around the world (gummies, chocolate, liquorice, hard candy), salty snacks, drinks and cereals.
companies.channels_supplied: Own online shop plus B2B supply to resellers, retailers and large customers across Germany, with no minimum order.
companies.fit_rationale: Carries over 830 sweet brands including British ones such as Cadbury and supplies resellers, so it could place Diablo with small shops in Jena. It is mainly an online retailer, which makes it a conditional wholesale route.
what_they_do_well: Runs one of Germany's largest online sweet shops, with over 9,000 items from more than 830 brands.

companies.name: Dovgan GmbH
companies.distributes: Imported Eastern European, Polish, Balkan, oriental and Vietnamese foods, including sweets and baked goods, plus frozen and food service ranges.
companies.channels_supplied: German food retail including REWE, and Eastern European food shops. Supply into Jena not confirmed.
companies.fit_rationale: An importer with sweets in its range and access to REWE and to the Russian and Eastern European shops found in Jena. Its focus is ethnic food, so sugar free sweets would sit outside its core story.
what_they_do_well: Described by Lebensmittel Zeitung (2015) as the market leader for Eastern European specialities in German food retail.

companies.name: Uplegger Food Company GmbH
companies.distributes: Chilled and frozen brands: dairy, cheese, desserts, ice cream, convenience and plant-based foods.
companies.channels_supplied: National and regional retail headquarters, independent retailers and selected food service and online customers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
companies.fit_rationale: Full service sales and distribution partner for international brands, with a track record bringing in British brands such as Gu and Cathedral City. It works only in chilled and frozen goods, so it fits only if Diablo had a chilled line.
what_they_do_well: Represents over 20 chilled and frozen brands, including Franui and The Vegetarian Butcher, for German, Austrian and Swiss retail.

companies.name: Naturkost Erfurt GmbH
companies.distributes: Full range organic and natural food wholesale, over 12,000 items including about 2,000 fresh lines.
companies.channels_supplied: Organic shops, farm shops, delivery services and caterers in Thuringia, Saxony, southern Saxony-Anhalt and northern Bavaria.
companies.fit_rationale: The regional organic wholesaler for Thuringia, reaching Jena's organic and health food shops. Flagged: it entered a self-administered restructuring in September 2026 and probably stocks certified organic goods only.
what_they_do_well: Has supplied organic shops, farm shops and caterers in Thuringia, Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt since 2003, with over 12,000 items.

companies.name: dennree GmbH
companies.distributes: Organic wholesale: dry goods, dairy, cheese, fruit and vegetables, frozen, meat and natural cosmetics.
companies.channels_supplied: Organic specialist retailers, including the group's denns BioMarkt stores, from Topen near Hof and regional sites. Jena stores not confirmed.
companies.fit_rationale: The largest organic wholesaler serving eastern Germany from Topen, about 100 km from Jena, with direct reach into organic stores. Conditional on certified organic products, which Diablo's range is not confirmed to have.
what_they_do_well: Central warehouse at Topen near Hof, with regional sites redistributing to organic stores across Germany and Austria.

companies.name: Azad Food GmbH
companies.distributes: Food wholesale: drinks, spices, dairy, fruit and vegetables, sauces, frozen goods and packaging. Sweets not confirmed.
companies.channels_supplied: Businesses in Thuringia and Bavaria (likely restaurants and food shops), delivered weekly or by pickup.
companies.fit_rationale: A small wholesaler about 15 km from Jena that delivers weekly to local food businesses. No confectionery range was confirmed, so it is a low priority add-on route.
what_they_do_well: Delivers weekly to businesses across Thuringia and Bavaria, with pickup also offered.
